name: Challenge explainers
summary: Explainer posts about the 9 rules, the 50 days, the price, the buddy programme. No price in feed posts.
slide_pattern: cover (the question) → list (the answer) → statement (the bridge) → cta (link in bio)
extra_voice_rules: Don't compare FIT50 to 75 Hard. The origin-story pillar may.
Feed posts don't show the price. Price lives on the link-in-bio page, in Stories, in DMs.
Rule names exact: Move Your Body, Step It Up, Wet The Lips, Fuel Right, Chill Out, Feed Your Brain, Open Mind, Crispy Clarity, Fresh Lungs.
Targets from facts.json. 10,000 steps. 2.5 litres. 10 minutes. 5 books or 30 minutes.
extra_checks: Every rule name in the post appears in facts.json#/habit_names/exact.
Every numeric value in the post equals a value in facts.json#/habit_targets or facts.json#/voice_numbers.
No `€` symbol in any field of the post. The cta must point to 'link in bio' copy, not a price.
